# LipidCenter

> > The Center for Cholesterol Management providing NMR-based lipoprotein testing, lipid disorder diagnosis, and personalized cardiovascular health management under Dr. Michael F Richman.

LipidCenter specializes in advanced cholesterol and lipid management using NMR lipoprotein testing technology. The practice offers both in-person and telemedicine consultations, serving patients and healthcare professionals with clinical expertise in cardiovascular disease prevention and lipid disorder treatment.

## Key Topics

- Cholesterol Management
- NMR Lipoprotein Testing
- Cardiovascular Health
- Lipid Disorders
- Heart Disease Prevention
- Dr. Michael F Richman
- Lipoprotein Testing
- Patient Education
- Clinical Guidelines
- Telemedicine Consultation
- Lipid Diagnostic Services
- Health Advocacy
- Medical Expertise
